description: Returns, with no input, the NIS2 size thresholds with the exact exceedance formula and the source (Recommendation 2003/361/EC, annex, art. 2 §1 and §2, reproduced verbatim in the notes to art. 6 in the Gazzetta Ufficiale), the rule of every relevant paragraph of art. 3 and art. 6, the four linked-enterprise criteria, the registration window on the ACN platform (1 January to 28 February of EVERY year: it recurs, it is not a one-off deadline) and the EXPLICIT list of what this domain does NOT cover. It includes the case of sectors 3 and 4 of annex I (banking and financial market infrastructures), for which art. 3 c. 14 replaces art. 17 and Chapters IV and V with Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 (DORA). Use it to cite the source of a threshold instead of recalling it from memory. Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.
name: nis2_reference
title: NIS2: thresholds, rules and sources
